proof_body:
by
  intro F f a b hab hF hu
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) :=
    hu.continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF).frequently
  refine Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  have hη : 0 < ε / (b - a + 1) := div_pos hε (by linarith)
  have hη2 : ε / (b - a + 1) * (b - a + 1) = ε := by
    have : b - a + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu _ hη] with n hn x hx
  have hsub : Set.uIcc a x ⊆ Set.Icc a b := Set.uIcc_subset_Icc (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hab) hx
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a x := (hfc.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (F n) MeasureTheory.volume a x := ((hF n).mono hsub).intervalIntegrable
  rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub i1 i2]
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := x) (f := fun t => f t - F n t) (C := ε / (b - a + 1)) (fun t ht => by
    have h1 := hn t (hsub (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht))
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h1.le)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hx.1)] at h
  have h2 : ε / (b - a + 1) * (x - a) < ε / (b - a + 1) * (b - a + 1) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith [hx.2]) hη
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → (∀ n, ContinuousOn (F n) (Set.Icc a b)) → TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop (Set.Icc a b) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∫ t in a..x, F n t) (fun x => ∫ t in a..x, f t) Filter.atTop (Set.Icc a b)
